sources.title: 15.1 independent arithmetic derivations
sources.details:
[1,2]@up=[1,2,3]; ReLU unchanged; @down=[4,5]. [2,1]@up=[2,1,3]; @down=[5,4]. 6+6=12 weights. Per row 12 scalar multiplications, 7 additions and 3 ReLU comparisons, independent of total row count.
[1,-2]@up=[1,-2,-1]; ReLU=[1,0,0]; @down=[1,0]. Three concatenated copies of 2 rows give 6 rows without changing either weight table.
64*256+256+256*64+64=33088 per FFN. Two such FFNs give66176; add token embedding16896, positions8192, block norms512, attention32768, final norm128, output16896 =>141568.
90288.34326171875 /39256=2.2999883651344697 =>2.29999; 97279.35034179688 /41914=2.320927383256117 =>2.32093. Story counts51/52 differ from chunk counts334/352; loss is token-weighted.
